flow: 1. Phase close runs verifier as normal
2. If verifier PASS: generate minimal phase-result memory record using TPL-001
3. Run validator (VAL-001 through VAL-015) on the memory record
4. If validator PASS or PASS_WITH_WARNINGS: write to External Conversation Space
5. If validator BLOCKED: log rejection, do not write, surface blocking issues
6. Generate Snapshot if Context Space active (use minimal Snapshot format)
7. Generate Attach Packet if required (use minimal Attach Packet format)
8. Update phase ledger with minimal summary (≤ 500 chars)

failure_handling.validator_blocked: Log rejection with reason. Do not write memory record. Surface to user.
failure_handling.evidence_path_missing: BLOCKED by VAL-001. Memory record rejected until path fixed.
